lead_raw_text:
The structure of Dy₈Fe₁₀ (reduced formula Dy₄Fe₅) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with 18 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows Dy centers with 12 geometric neighbors (9 Dy, 3 Fe) and Fe centers with 14 or 15 neighbors (Fe and Dy), with neighbor distances spanning roughly 2.71–3.53 Å. The periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D-connected component containing all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between 14-vertex Fe polyhedra, and corner- and face-sharing between Dy and Fe polyhedra.
